reason: Not refuted on feasibility (0 GPU, no pipeline change, post-deadline, outside R8), but refuted on value/validity as specified. (1) Group A is already pre-registered: private-read (c) (CONTEXT l.2582-2584) has the unrounded-order read 'fraction of public-0.955-0.957 teams ranked above the X copy run, plus median rank change'; R14L-7 re-does it in a worse, rounded form. (2) Quantization kills the statistic: scores are 3-dp strings with no unrounded field; the C exact copies share one private value; A's median public is 0.955 (63 of 120), so the denominator is exactly 0.002 and f_A can only be 0, 0.5, 1, ...: the 0.3 threshold is dead and a true +0.0005 transfer flips on rounding; f_us = diff/0.001 is an integer in {-1,0,1,2} and says nothing beyond C1-C4. (3) Not identified: band is not route. A contains model-work teams (y3uanm distilled secondary FT 0.956, hikaggler synthetic pretraining + fusion 0.957) and PP-only teams (Justin CH123 0.956); 47/81 B members have no artifact and some B teams probed publicly (Quantizr 11 subs). So 'R7 protected / R9 cost' cannot be read off f_A vs f_B. (4) Bias toward the preferred conclusion: A is selected on one-embryo public noise (winner's curse, f_A < 1 even under real transfer); max-of-2 finals with an x138 hedge floor private at C (f >= 0); a private-embryo scale shift moves both f against the fixed 0.3/0.5 thresholds; late scores after the 23:27Z snapshot move public. Whatever comes out, the interpretations would justify R7/R9 in hindsight without really testing them. It adds zero expected private score.
fix: Do not add R14L-7 as written. Optional replacement (curator, before 29 Sep 23:00Z, text only): extend private-read (c) with a descriptive B arm using the same rank-based statistic as A, i.e. the fraction of public 0.960-0.966 teams (from the bb224de9 snapshot) ranked above the C exact-copy run on private, plus their median rank change. Label both arms 'band, not route; selection-biased; one draw; no lesson on R7/R9'. Drop f_us and the three pre-written route conclusions. If a ratio is wanted, report f_A/f_B (scale-free) with the 0.001 quantization caveat and no thresholds.
realistic_gain: 0 on the private/public score (post-deadline calibration only). The learning value of the band-level transfer read is weak: about 1 eng-h on 30 Sep, and most of the A arm already exists in (c).
